instruction:
Multi-Board Consistency Check

Two boards, /home/user/Desktop/board_a.kicad_pcb and /home/user/Desktop/board_b.kicad_pcb, each contain a power-supply subsection (footprints carry a property "section" whose value is "POWER"). The two subsections are expected to be schematically identical because they derive from the same reusable subcircuit, but board_b has drifted and now differs from board_a in a small number of ways. The non-power portions of the two boards are intentionally different and must be preserved.

1. Diff the power subsections of board_a vs board_b and enumerate every difference.
2. Produce a corrected board_b in which the power subsection matches board_a while the non-power portion is left untouched.

Requirements:
1. Write /home/user/Desktop/delta.csv with header exactly:
item_type,refdes_or_net,board_a_value,board_b_value,difference_kind
One row per difference found. Report each difference exactly once. No spurious rows.
2. Write /home/user/Desktop/board_b_synced.kicad_pcb: a valid KiCad PCB s-expression whose POWER-section footprints and net names agree with board_a, and whose non-POWER footprints match board_b unchanged.
3. The synced board_b must parse as a KiCad PCB, must not reference any renamed net that was only in the drifted board_b, and must contain every component that exists in board_a's POWER section.

Write /home/user/Desktop/delta.csv and /home/user/Desktop/board_b_synced.kicad_pcb.
